title: fsl-testgen plugin protocol 1: response
description: The one JSON document an external target executable writes to its standard output, with exit status 0. fsl-testgen checks it and writes the files; the executable writes nothing itself. Beyond this schema fsl-testgen rejects a path that is given twice.

path.description: Where the file goes, relative to the output directory, with `/` between components. Not absolute, no drive letter, no `.` or `..` component, no empty component, no backslash, no NUL.

content.description: The whole text of the file.

severity.description: `error` refuses the generation: nothing is written and fsl-testgen exits with the messages. `warning` and `info` are passed on to the user after a successful generation.
